title: Appium storage deletion can escape its storage directory
summary: The Appium storage plugin does not sanitize names passed to its deletion endpoint. An unauthenticated request can traverse outside the storage directory and recursively delete files writable by the Appium process.

severity.rationale: Unauthenticated network requests can destroy source trees, artifacts and other writable host files. CI and developer automation commonly run Appium with access beyond its storage directory, so the integrity impact extends beyond one service.

exposure: The storage plugin must be enabled and its HTTP endpoint reachable. Deletion is limited by the Appium process filesystem permissions.

remediation.risk: Low. Validate storage operations after updating.

verification: Check the plugin version used by the running server; verify ordinary upload and deletion using disposable test data.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.
